final: WITH c AS (SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), s AS (SELECT observstation, cnt, 100.0*cnt/(SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM c) AS share FROM c), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT SUM(s.cnt) AS total_telescopes, AVG(s.share) AS avg_share, AVG(s.share - a.avg_share) AS avg_excess FROM s, a WHERE s.share > a.avg_share
